recap.text: The Maestro's gift for Carl alone is a cardboard box, and Carl opens it and laughs. Inside are brand-new Bates zip-up tactical boots, identical to his service boots and in his size, with socks packed in. Carl says they will be comfortable in a safe room and puts the lid back on, because his soles have acclimated and his buffs and skills only work barefoot. He tells the orc he loves them and hopes they weren't too expensive.

beats.headline: A present for Carl
beats.text: The Maestro's gift for his VIPs is a literal cardboard box, for Carl alone, something the orc says Carl wants really bad. Carl opens it and has to laugh. Inside is a brand-new pair of Bates zip-up tactical boots, identical to the service boots he wore on active duty, in his size, and the Maestro adds that there are socks in the box too. These will be really comfortable in a safe room, Carl says, and puts the lid back on. His soles have fully acclimated, several of his buffs and skills only work barefoot, and the orc knows it. I love them, Carl adds. I hope they weren't too expensive.
beats.gist: Carl laughs at the Maestro's boots, Bates zip-ups in his size, and boxes them for safe rooms.
